summary:
開拓重工EPS大超預期近20%，營收年增22%顯示工程機械與能源需求強勁回溫。
• EPS 5.47美元，大幅超越預期4.57美元，超預期幅度19.60%
• 營收174.1億美元，年增22.22%，反映基建與資源開採需求旺盛
• 獲利超預期幅度遠大於營收，顯示定價能力與營運效率提升
• 受惠於全球基礎建設投資與能源資本支出循環
ai_view:
訊號強勁：EPS大幅超預期搭配22%營收年增，顯示需求與定價力同步走高，景氣循環向上特徵明顯。短期股價有強力支撑，惟46倍本益比已對應市場樂觀預期，須提防循環見頂風險。中期關注基建法案執行、礦業與能源資本支出，以及積壓訂單（backlog）能否延續。追蹤指標：各部門營收年增、營業利潤率、積壓訂單、經銷商庫存與大宗商品價格。

需留意：本益比46.59倍偏高，對景氣循環股而言估值已不便宜；工程機械需求與全球經濟及大宗商品價格高度連動；關稅與供應鏈成本可能侵蝕利潤率

summary_en:
Caterpillar crushed EPS by ~20% with 22% revenue growth, signaling robust machinery and energy demand.
• EPS of $5.47 sharply beat the $4.57 estimate by 19.60%
• Revenue of $17.41B grew 22.22%, reflecting strong infrastructure and resource-extraction demand
• Earnings beat far exceeded revenue, indicating pricing power and operating efficiency gains
• Benefiting from global infrastructure investment and the energy capex cycle

ai_view_en:
Signal is strong: a large EPS beat with 22% revenue growth shows demand and pricing power rising together, a classic upcycle signature. Near-term the stock has solid support, but a 46x P/E already reflects optimism, so watch for cycle-peak risk. Mid-term, monitor infrastructure spending execution, mining and energy capex, and backlog durability. Track: segment revenue growth, operating margin, backlog, dealer inventory, and commodity prices.

Watch：A 46.59x P/E is elevated for a cyclical industrial name; Machinery demand is highly tied to the global economy and commodity prices; Tariffs and supply-chain costs could erode margins
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期19.60%且營收年增22.22%，量價齊揚。
